name: pyRevit Bridge
description: Discover existing pyRevit pushbutton scripts and run them behind the approval gate. Execution inside Revit requires a bridge command that is NOT implemented yet (see docs/pyrevit-bridge.md).
author: AEC Model Bridge

script_id.description: Script id as returned by list_pyrevit_scripts, for example '0:Tools.extension/Tab.tab/Panel.panel/Do It.pushbutton/script.py'.
Script id exactly as used in the approved plan.

script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the script that was previewed and approved (from plan_run_pyrevit_script). The run is refused if the file on disk no longer matches.

plan_id.description: ID of the approved ActionPlan authorising this run. Required.
